WhatsApp opens on the chat. You attach the photo and press Send.
WhatsApp opens on the chat. Attach the photo and it is sent for you — no final tap.
Auto mode needs the accessibility service. Turn on “WhatsApp Direct auto-send”.
Greyed out? Open App info and choose “Allow restricted settings” first.
Presses Send on the photo you attach, in the chat this app opened

Finishes a send you started here: when you tap Initiate WhatsApp in Auto mode, this service waits for the photo you attach in that chat and presses Send once, then stops. It reads WhatsApp screens only while a send is in progress, checks the chat is the number you typed, and never stores or transmits anything.
